# YSenseAI

> Open-source, consent-first platform for human-written stories and cultural wisdom as AI training and evaluation data. Contributors write a story, an AI extracts five perception layers and a three-word essence, the contribution gets a tamper-evident attribution record and a Z-Protocol consent tier, and the library exports in JSONL, Alpaca, ShareGPT and CSV. Beta software; one maintainer; no licensing deals yet.

- Landing page: https://ysenseai.org
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/creator35lwb-web/YSense-AI-Attribution-Infrastructure
- Run locally: `pip install -r v45_beta/requirements_production.txt && streamlit run v45_beta/app_final.py`
- UX demo (mock-up, no AI calls): https://huggingface.co/spaces/YSenseAI/wisdom-canvas
- Maintainer: Alton Lee Wei Bin, Teluk Intan, Malaysia (alton@ysenseai.org)

- [Z-Protocol v2.1 update: data withdrawal means exclusion from future training, not erasure from trained models](https://github.com/creator35lwb-web/YSense-AI-Attribution-Infrastructure/blob/main/docs/z-protocol/Z-PROTOCOL-V2.1-UPDATE-NOTICE.md)
- [October 2026 deep analysis and market report](https://github.com/creator35lwb-web/YSense-AI-Attribution-Infrastructure/blob/main/docs/audits/2026-10-07-deep-analysis-and-market-report.md)

## Current state (October 2026)

- Attribution is tamper-evident (SHA-256 fingerprint and author identifier), not key-signed. Key-based signatures (did:key) and C2PA manifests are planned.
- Quality metrics are keyword heuristics for writer feedback, not validated measures of training value.
- Consent is recorded per contribution with the document version; withdrawal excludes data from future training and cannot remove influence from already-trained models.
- Revenue share (15-30% by tier) is written into the terms; no AI lab has licensed anything yet and nothing has been paid out.
- Next milestone: a gated Hugging Face dataset of 500 to 1,000 consented, signed stories with at least 40% Bahasa Melayu or Manglish, plus an evaluation set.

## Related projects

- [VerifiMind PEAS](https://verifimind.io): multi-agent AI validation MCP server (same maintainer)
- [GodelAI](https://github.com/creator35lwb-web/godelai): wisdom-preserving small language model research (same maintainer)
